Name: PantsGoneWild
Author: NumekoAkeno
Description:
[b]PantsGoneWild[/b]
Get ready for a fun twist on your Stardew Valley experience! The Pants Party Mod randomizes your character's pants color and type while you play.
The goal is to add a playful element to your game without changing the core mechanics!
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Randomly change pants color and type while moving.
[*]Configure how quickly pants change based on your settings.
[*]Options to always keep the pants changing, even when standing still.
[*]Easy access to settings with a configurable button.
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 3.0.0+.
[*]Place the folder in the Mods folder.
[/list][b]Compatibility
[/b]- Tested with buff pants where you can change the pants visual without losing the main pant buff. (If you are using buff on cloths) 
- This mod may not work well with other clothing or color-changing mods.
[b]Note[/b]
This mod is still in development, so it may have some bugs. Feel free to tell me about any issues or ask simple questions!
